integrity: Explicit integral topology proof with independent finite mod-two and signed character consistency checks; no external certification.
scientific_limitations: Rooted height-two trees with at least two nonempty branches and r=2 only; the group fixes the specified root. The integral homology module is proved, but no equivariant PL homeomorphism or all-tree classification is claimed. Regular perfect branching has previously known ordinary homotopy results; independence and exhaustive uniqueness have not been established.
title: Root-deletion equivalence and integral symmetry of two-independence complexes of height-two trees
